issues.evidence: Spectral balance: sub 13.3% plus low 37.6% means 51% of the energy is below 250 Hz. Mid 1–4k is 13.1% (target ≥15 with near-continuous VO), presence 3.1% and air 3.2%. The VO chain's +3 dB at 3 kHz is not enough to lift the mix.
issues.suggested_action: High-pass the beds at 120 Hz (heart and bass_pulse at 40 Hz), shelve -3 dB below 200 Hz on music, and put a +2 dB shelf above 6 kHz on the VO.

issues.evidence: The SFX bus is not ducked, and stings sit on VO starts: done_chime 11.05 under 'It says…' (match 0.78), identity 46.2 under 'See exactly…', identity 107.95 under 'Done.', identity 118.8 under 'Agentic Office.' (heard 'see you next time', 0.32).
issues.suggested_action: Duck stings and chimes 4–6 dB from the VO key (attack 5 ms, release 250 ms), or retime them off the first words.

issues.evidence: cuts_on_sound_pct is 31.1, and 31 of 45 cuts have no audible event. The cut touches at 0.18 disappear in the master.
issues.suggested_action: Raise the cut transients to land about 6–8 dB above the bed at each cut, and use 50–150 ms pre-lap J-cuts of the next scene's bed on location changes (46, 49, 107.9, 112.4).

issues.evidence: The chain runs a single-pass loudnorm with I=-14.3, TP=-2 and LRA=11 (dynamic AGC mode), then +1.9 dB and a 0.79 limiter. Dynamic loudnorm rides gain and can flatten the designed dips. True peak lands at -1.6, only 0.1 dB inside spec.
issues.suggested_action: Run two-pass loudnorm (linear=true) with measured values, I=-14, TP=-1.5. Then use a true-peak limiter at -1.8 dBTP and drop the extra +1.9 dB stage.

issues.evidence: Windows at -68.0 and -65.3 dBFS against a -14.3 LUFS programme. This is a 50 dB hole on the cut to the end card, and at the last frame.
issues.suggested_action: Hold a room-tone floor at about -48 dBFS through both.

issues.evidence: No vo_over_music measurement is available. With ratio-5 ducking (threshold 0.03, attack 12 ms, release 350 ms) under VO at about 4 words/s, the beds pump between words; the loudness curve swings, for example -11.8/-19.1/-20.6 at 4.5–5.5 s.
issues.suggested_action: Use a fixed -7 dB duck with a 150 ms attack and 600 ms release (or a ratio of 3), and measure VO-over-bed to reach ≥8 dB.

mix_recipe.vo_bus: HPF 90 Hz; -2 dB at 250 Hz (Q 1); +3 dB at 3 kHz (Q 1.2); +2 dB high shelf at 6.5 kHz; de-ess 6–8 kHz at -4 dB max; gentle 2:1 compression, 3 dB GR
mix_recipe.beds_ducking: sidechain from VO: ratio 3, threshold set for 6–8 dB GR, attack 120–150 ms, release 500–700 ms; plus a dynamic EQ dip of -3 dB at 1.5–4 kHz on music while the VO is present
mix_recipe.sfx_bus: stings and chimes keyed to the VO: -5 dB, attack 5 ms, release 250 ms; cut transients left undducked
mix_recipe.ambience: HPF 120 Hz on room and city beds; hold floor ≥ -50 dBFS; never ducked more than 4 dB
mix_recipe.low_end: HPF beds at 120 Hz except deliberate heart and pulse at 40 Hz; music low shelf -3 dB at 200 Hz
mix_recipe.master: two-pass loudnorm linear=true, I=-14.0, TP=-1.5, LRA target 7–9; then a true-peak limiter at -1.8 dBTP, 4x oversampling; no post-gain

top_revision: Key the stings and chimes to the VO (or retime them off first words), and rebalance the tonality (beds HPF 120 Hz, -3 dB below 200 Hz, VO +2 dB above 6 kHz), so that the mid band clears 15% and the brand tag stops being masked.
